label: Diagram 3.6
caption: Diagram 3.6 Multi-storey flat with protected entrance hall and landing
description: Diagram 3.6, titled "Multi-storey flat with protected entrance hall and landing", is headed by a green band reading "entrance level" and carries the reference "See para 3.21" at top left. It shows two plan drawings. The left, "a. Entrance level", is a rectangular plan with a grey-shaded protected landing/entrance hall on its left side, containing a hatched stair symbol at the top and a "WC" symbol at the bottom. A vertical dimension "9m max." runs through this area, and two door arcs marked "Fd" appear on its right boundary; the base is labelled "Flat entrance". The right plan, "b. Level(s) above or below entrance level", shows a similar grey-shaded protected area with a hatched stair symbol and four "Fd" door arcs around it, the base labelled "Alternative exit". A legend on the right defines the green line as "Fire resisting construction (minimum REI 30)", "Fd" as "Fire doorset", and the grey square as "Protected landing/ entrance hall". A note reads: "NOTE: This only applies where at least one storey is more than 4.5m above ground level."
